# Glossary of specialist terms the transcription API tends to misspell.
# Copy this file to glossary.txt (gitignored) and add your own terms, or point
# TRANSCRIBE_GLOSSARY in .env at a glossary elsewhere.
#
# Format, one term per line:
#     Canonical Spelling: misspelling, other misspelling
# Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive. Spaces and hyphens in a variant match
# either, so "omo plata" also catches "omo-plata". The canonical spelling itself is
# matched too, so its capitalization is normalized. A line with no colon only does that.
#
# Add a variant whenever a new misspelling shows up in outputs/raw/.

Omoplata: omoplatte, omoplatta, omo plata
Kimura: kimora
De la Riva: della riva, de la reeva
Kesa Gatame: kesa gatami
Berimbolo: barimbolo
